items: Treat reputation management as an ongoing growth activity: everything guests experience, from food quality and wait times to listing accuracy and review recency, shapes whether new guests choose you.
Reply to every review promptly, using the guest's name, mentioning something specific they wrote, addressing any small complaint and inviting them back.
Tag reviews by operational area and break ratings down by location, so recurring complaints point you to the kitchen, staffing or process problem behind them.
Track star rating per platform and location, review volume, response rate and time, sentiment and guest recovery rate, with Google Business Profile as your first priority.
Momos uses AI to collect and categorize reviews across all your locations and platforms, showing which locations are underperforming and why.
